findings.evidence: Naturality.lean:81-88 and :90-97 — docstring "is preserved by homomorphisms of affine groups" over statements `semisimplePart k H₁ K (toConv (g.ofConv.comp (φ : H₁ →ₐ[k] H₂))) = toConv ((semisimplePart k H₂ K g).ofConv.comp ↑φ)`. `AlgHom.mapDomain_apply` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Hopf/Map.lean:79-80) is what relates the two forms; nothing in the file says so. The author's own PR-comment explanation of this normal form exists only in the review thread, not in the source.
findings.fix: In both docstrings, state the equation the lemma proves (semisimple/unipotent part commutes with `AlgHom.mapDomain φ`) and add one sentence noting the statement is the `AlgHom.mapDomain_apply`-normalized spelling of `mapDomain φ g` required by `simpNF` for these `@[simp]` lemmas. This asks only for a docstring note; it does not ask for the statement form to change, so it is compatible with the author's reply on the api-design thread (id 3771724895) defending the unfolded statements.
findings.issue: `semisimplePart_mapDomain` (line 81) and `unipotentPart_mapDomain` (line 90) are documented as "The semisimple/unipotent part of a point is preserved by homomorphisms of affine groups", but (a) "preserved" describes invariance, whereas the theorems assert a commutation `semisimplePart (mapDomain φ g) = mapDomain φ (semisimplePart g)`, and (b) neither statement mentions `AlgHom.mapDomain` at all — both are written in the unfolded `toConv (g.ofConv.comp ↑φ)` simp-normal form, so the name and docstring do not describe what the reader sees.

summary: Documentation is otherwise complete and accurate, but the two component lemmas in Naturality.lean carry docstrings that neither match their statement form nor state the actual equation: they are named `*_mapDomain` and described in `mapDomain` terms while the statements are spelled in the unfolded `toConv (g.ofConv.comp φ)` form, with no note explaining the mismatch.
